newsitem.title: THAILAND: BBC bank loss seen after loan provisions.
newsitem.headline: BBC bank loss seen after loan provisions.

text.p: Auditors of Bangkok Bank of Commerce Plc (BBC) on Friday attributed its 970.9 million baht ($38.5 million) first half year loss to a 5.2 billion baht reserve the bank provided for its 48.6 billion baht doubtful loans, the bank's auditor note said.
The 48.6 billion baht doubtful loans at end-June were part of BBC's estimated 70 billion baht non-performing loans.
The BBC auditor's note said the 5.2 billion baht doubtful loan provision included two billion baht drawn from its unappropriated retained earnings.
A bank spokesman said that although the increased provision still fell short of a Bank of Thailand requirement, it showed that the bank had started addressing its non-performing loan problems.

BBC has been run by a government-appointed rescue committee following its takeover by the finance ministry. The committee has proposed that BBC raise its capital by 25 billion baht and through a five-year domestic convertible debenture issue.
